cleanup_if_future_launch_allowed: Use only the timestamped isolated user-data dir and isolated extensions dir named in the launch contract.
After the future run exits, terminate only the Cursor process tree created by that run id.
Archive stdout/stderr/network/process monitor artifacts under the run folder.
Delete the isolated user-data and isolated extensions dirs only after evidence is copied/redacted and checks pass.
Remove any temporary network deny/monitor rule created for that exact future process tree.
forbidden_cleanup: Do not delete user profile Cursor dirs
Do not kill unrelated existing editor processes
